summary: Regression re-test after AuthContext + PhoneAuthTab fix — ALL 4 requested flows PASS. (1) Merchant phone OTP (+919876543211 / Merchant Tester / 123456) correctly lands on /merchant/onboarding (screenshot confirms step 1 'Business info' rendered) — previously redirected to /sign-in. (2) Customer phone OTP (+919876543212 / Cust Tester / 123456) — useAuth().user is populated: profile-name testID renders 'Cust Tester'. (3) Profile tab shows signed-in user name after both OTP and email flows, proving AuthContext.setSession propagates state. (4) Email sign-up + email sign-in regressions clean (profile-name shows 'Email Reg' and 'SI Regr' respectively). Only lingering console noise: previously-reported deprecated shadow* / pointerEvents warnings — not introduced by this fix.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Migrate `shadow*` style tokens in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts to `boxShadow` for RN Web to remove console warning.
OPTIONAL: Grep for `pointerEvents=` in /app/frontend and move to `style={{pointerEvents:'none'}}`.

OPTIONAL (code review, iteration 8 carry-over): merchant/onboarding.tsx useEffect at line 87 redirects on `!user` without awaiting `loading` from useAuth() — no longer triggered by OTP flow (fix works) but still a subtle race for cold-loads.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.setSession implementation is clean: writes secure storage first, then syncs token+user state, then memoized in context — no race with downstream consumers.

AuthContext.refresh now falls back to secure storage if in-memory token missing — good hedge but the primary path via setSession already covers PhoneAuthTab. Consider dropping the fallback later if not needed elsewhere.
PhoneAuthTab correctly awaits setSession before calling onSuccess, so downstream navigation guards (e.g. merchant/onboarding useEffect) see a populated user.
